_readme: Cards that are banned. Key = card id (from its page link, #/card/<id>). Each card has a list of bans, one per format. format: 'Epic' or 'Standard'. where: "all" for every scenario, or a list of scenario names. note (optional): one short sentence. since (optional): e.g. 'Epic Rules v1.0' or a date. stagingTest: true shows the ban ONLY on staging.xwingarchives.com - for trying things out, never for a real ban.
